patches.description: Render the B2B account page as a nav-left/content-right sidebar. The page authors a 30%/70% split via Section Metadata (data-column-width), but the boilerplate only lays sections into a row under body.columns with a --column-width var, and nothing translates the authored attribute. This decorates data-column-width sections into the var + adds body.columns, so the existing body.columns flex rule renders the sidebar (mobile stacks below 900px). Layout only - no styling.
patches.exit: TODO: file PR to hlxsites/aem-boilerplate-commerce to honor section data-column-width; delete on merge

patches.description: Redirect a published PDP whose SKU no longer resolves to the native 404 instead of mounting an empty drop-in. The warm path: a previously-published PDP serves 200 from the content bus, so the CDN-404 smart-404 snippet never runs; fetchProductData resolves null for an unknown SKU and the initializer mounted anyway.
patches.exit: file PR to adobe-commerce/boilerplate-b2b-template; delete on merge
